text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —It was a time that felt like a "dream."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Ooooooohhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —YAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhhーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...! Amazing, amazing!! 
Incredible!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's passion! Their brilliance! 
Their "dreams"!! I can feel all of it 
rushing vividly into my body!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOAAAAAAHHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(—If only this time... could go on forever 
and ever...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO~~~~!!! This year's Takarazuka 
Kinen was the absolute best!! It really 
felt like a "dream" Grand Prix!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, that really gave me something to 
dream about! That's how a Grand Prix race 
ought to be!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo excited for the year-end Arima 
Kinen too! If Oguri joins in, it's gonna 
be insane!! I can hardly wait~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone. That was truly a wonderful 
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I will, too... Someday, without fail, I 
will run alongside all of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Staking my life and my "dream," all of 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —I'm so glad I got to run this race.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Even after finishing the run, it's 
still... still burning. The heat of the 
"dreams" I received from everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Give me more of this heat! More! Burn it 
even hotter!! I will—!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Yaeno...! Thanks for an amazing race!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fufu. As expected, you never change.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Next, you will be aiming for the 
Sprinters Stakes, correct? And beyond 
that—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes!! Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I will fight Oguri-senpai. ...A head-on 
clash with my destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Then this time it is my turn to 
support your 'dream.'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the pinnacle of sprinting, and 
then— please let me bear witness to your 
flames that will burn away even the 
beast's fangs.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—I will support Bamboo-san's "dream" 
together with Yaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And also— we definitely have to run 
together again someday!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Ardan-san, who came to watch 
today, feels the exact same way...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Someday, in a race where our "dreams" 
cross paths again... I swear it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Haha! Everyone's looking great! Well, 
that was a hell of a fun race for me too, 
though!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well now, that just makes me look forward 
to our next chance to race――

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, Bamboo-senpai is... just that 
kind of person, isn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Man, and after I made such a big deal 
about that last race being the big one, 
here I am itching to run again...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even though I ran the absolute best race 
of my life... knowing that I might be able 
to run even harder... it lit a whole new 
fire in my chest—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You better take responsibility someday, 
Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Welcoming Bamboo Memory back with a 
refreshed look on her face after giving it 
her absolute all—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thank you for letting me run in 
this Takarazuka Kinenâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It just hit me all over again!! My 
rivals... this entire generation...! 
They're truly the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna become the strongest, 
most awesome horse girl of this 
generation! No, I WILL become one!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I'm gonna become Oguri-senpai's 
greatest rival ever!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes...!! I am 
DEF-I-NITE-LY going to win!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Truly taking in the heat of her 
generation— Bamboo Memory's battle for her 
'dream' was reaching its climax!!"
